description: Where Ospitario has public passports: every municipality with at least one, its region (Italy) and country, how many passports (and how many of them unclaimed, tier L0), and its list page; and the named areas holding them (Salento, provinces, parks, islands) with their counts. Call it when the traveler names a place, before searching: a named area listed in areas is searched with search_properties area=<name>; a municipality or area listed in neither has no passport on Ospitario yet; say so instead of searching it. Coverage is still small and grows week by week. Every result is a property with a proven listing (L2/L2c), a verified operator (L3), a right to manage verified by document review (LA) or, marked L0 and unclaimed, facts from the operator's official website with nothing proven; the result names the tier and the date it was reached, and whether the registration number (Italy: CIN) was checked against the public register. Contact is direct with the operator and commission-free, so the traveler pays no platform fee. No result means nothing proven matches; nothing is inferred, estimated or filled in.
